deploy-bot: STAGING CUTOVER SIGNAL — starting deploy to staging (change window: 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC).
commit/tag: v2.14.0-stg (sha: `a1b2c3d4`). CI: ✅ all checks green.
runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/staging-deploy-2.14.0
canary strategy: staged ramp (10% -> 30% -> 100%). Notifying @maya @leo for preflight.

maya: ack. quick Q — if we need to roll back, which tag do we pin to?

leo: preflight smoke starting on canary pods now (3 replicas). hitting healthchecks and basic inference flows.

deploy-bot: preflight summary: DB migrations: none. Feature flags: none toggled. Canary pods 3/3 Ready. Logs: https://logs.redwood/staging/4361234567/preflight

zara: seeing a transient 502 from reranker on canary at ~02:06 UTC, single host. retrying requests, digging into logs.

maya: hold traffic shift — pausing ramp until reranker ok. setting canary rate -> 0% pause.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift paused by @maya. Canary halted at 10%. Waiting for ops confirmation.

leo: investigating root cause. initial signal looks like cold-start memory pressure on the model worker; scaling canary replica pool to 4 and re-warming caches.

zara: warmup done, reranker responding 200 consistently now. monitoring for 5m window.

maya: seeing steady success for 4m. recommend resume ramp at 02:15 UTC: 30% immediately then 100% after 10m if stable.

deploy-bot: Resume approved by @maya. Initiating staged ramp: 30% -> 100% over 10m. Pinning tag v2.14.0-stg for staging traffic.

akshay: note — pin job kicked off for downstream feature flags and infra toggles; will confirm alignment in ~2m.

deploy-bot: STAGING deploy COMPLETE — all healthchecks and canary metrics within thresholds. Rollforward to v2.14.0-stg finished.
Duration: ~12m from start to completion. Artifacts: s3://releases/redwood/v2.14.0-stg/. CI artifacts: https://ci.redwood/builds/4361234567. :party_parrot:

maya: thanks all — I'll start a short release note for staging observations and any follow-ups.

zara: observed a small latency spike at 02:21 UTC during the ramp (p50 up ~120ms -> 180ms) but within SLO. will add to postmortem notes.

leo: filing a brief ops doc for the cold-start behavior and recommended warmup knobs: https://intra.redwood/ops/cold-start-notes/4361234567

maya: closing thread, ping if anything else crops up overnight.
__notes: Generated mock Slack thread for staging deploy signal and completion; adheres to agents.md schema (flat JSON, strings and list of strings).
